name: Kustánszeg (Hungary)
description: Three equal vertical stripes of red, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kustánszeg (a red, green and blue shield with a church, a horseman and a fish) between the name KUSTÁNSZEG above and KÖZSÉG ÖNKORMÁNYZATA below in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
